text: 中国证监会就《私募投资母基金管理规定（征求意见稿）》公开征求意见。结合境内外实践和广泛市场调研，《母基金规定》从不同维度对母基金提出了投资分散度要求，避免集中投向单只基金、单一管理人、单一资产等，切实体现母基金分散投资的基本特征。同时，考虑创业投资基金特征，以及支持社会保障基金、保险资金、合格境外投资者、国家级政府投资基金等长期资金投资母基金等合理情形，《母基金规定》适当设置了差异化投资比例要求。
text_en: The CSRC publicly solicited comments on the Provisions on the Administration of Private Investment Fund-of-Funds (Draft for Comment). Based on domestic and overseas practices and extensive market research, the Fund-of-Funds Provisions set investment diversification requirements for fund-of-funds from different dimensions, avoiding concentrated investment in a single fund, a single manager, or a single asset, and effectively reflecting the basic feature of diversified investment by fund-of-funds. At the same time, taking into account the characteristics of venture capital funds and reasonable circumstances such as supporting long-term capital including social security funds, insurance funds, qualified foreign investors, and national-level government investment funds in investing in fund-of-funds, the Fund-of-Funds Provisions appropriately set differentiated investment ratio requirements.
